# MECHA BURST

> MECHA BURST is a portrait (vertical) mech shooter for iPhone and iPad by solo developer Yota Hamada. You pilot a humanoid combat mech, lead a wing of allies, and grow your units by earning funds and choosing upgrade cards. The Earth campaign is free; one in-app purchase unlocks the rest. No ads, no account, plays offline.

## What it is

- Genre: 2D mech shooter (shoot 'em up) played in portrait on a phone or tablet, with free 360° flight across a battlefield larger than the screen.
- Core loop: sortie, fight, earn funds. Each time the funds gauge fills, pick one of three upgrade cards that raises a pod type a level (Lv1 to Lv4). In battle, downed enemies drop pods that fight beside you for the rest of that battle, as strong as their card level. Buy and switch between mechs, and lead more wingmen as your rank rises.
- Combat: left stick to fly, right pad to fire, a beam saber up close, and a booster dash with a moment of invincibility. Grazing bullets near death slows time.
- Content: 5 campaigns from Earth to the Sun; 5 kinds of battlefield (orbit, fortress, open ground, city, asteroid belt) with weather and night; 22 named enemies with signature attacks; 10 pod types (homing missile, prism laser, funnel, Tesla arc, spinning blade, mace, flame pod, laser, machine gun, Aegis shield) plus 3 support cards.
- Origin: a full remake of the Japanese feature-phone game 宇宙防衛軍 (Uchū Bōeigun, "Space Defense Force") by its original creator.

## Facts

- Platforms: iPhone and iPad (iOS). Not on Android or PC.
- Price: free download. The Earth campaign is completely free. The four campaigns from Mars to the Sun unlock with a one-time in-app purchase called "Full Version". No subscriptions, no consumables, no ads.
- Offline: plays without a connection; only buying or restoring the Full Version uses the App Store.
- Languages: English, Japanese, German, French, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese.
- Saves: stored on the device only.
- Age rating: 13+ on the App Store.
